description: This source file defines the ChatController class, which manages chat sessions, message handling, health checks, session switching, and event processing for an AI chat application on Android. It interacts with a GatewaySession for server communication, maintains state flows for reactive UI updates, and handles events such as chat messages, agent interactions, and health status.

classes.name: ChatController
classes.description: Main class managing chat sessions, message flow, event handling, and server communication in the chat application.

methods.name: onDisconnected
methods.description: Handles disconnection events, updating health status and clearing pending operations.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a new session based on a session key.

methods.name: applyMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets and applies the main session key, updating the current session accordingly.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the chat state by reinitializing data from the server.

methods.name: refreshSessions
methods.description: Fetches an updated list of chat sessions.

methods.name: setThinkingLevel
methods.description: Sets the AI thinking level (e.g., low, medium, high).

methods.name: switchSession
methods.description: Switches to a different chat session by session key.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a user message with optional attachments and thinking level.

methods.name: sendMessageAwaitAcceptance
methods.description: Sends a message and awaits server acknowledgment, updating message state accordingly.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts all pending chat runs.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming real-time events from the gateway, updating state based on event type.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes chat by subscribing, fetching history, and polling health.

methods.name: fetchSessions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of chat sessions.

methods.name: pollHealthIfNeeded
methods.description: Performs a health check with throttling.

methods.name: handleChatEvent
methods.description: Handles incoming chat-related events such as message delta, finalization, or errors.

methods.name: handleAgentEvent
methods.description: Manages agent-related events, including streaming assistant responses and tool call phases.

methods.name: parseAssistantDeltaText
methods.description: Extracts streaming assistant text content from delta messages.

methods.name: publishPendingToolCalls
methods.description: Updates the list of pending tool calls for UI display.

methods.name: armPendingRunTimeout
methods.description: Schedules a timeout for pending runs to prevent indefinite waiting.

methods.name: clearPendingRun
methods.description: Removes a run from pending with cancellation of its timeout job.

methods.name: clearPendingRuns
methods.description: Clears all pending runs and cancels their timeouts.

methods.name: parseHistory
methods.description: Parses chat history JSON into message objects, reconciling message IDs.

methods.name: parseMessageContent
methods.description: Converts JSON elements into ChatMessageContent objects.

methods.name: parseSessions
methods.description: Parses JSON response into a list of chat session entries.

methods.name: parseRunId
methods.description: Extracts runId from response JSON.

methods.name: normalizeThinking
methods.description: Standardizes a string to recognized thinking levels.
